description.p: Pergament shows today's text, the Bible with a study pane, your library, the weekly meeting material, and your own notes and highlights, in a flat interface that keeps out of the way of the text.

It is a desktop app for Linux, a command line tool called pergament, and the Rust library underneath both. It is unofficial and not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Jehovah's Witnesses or the Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society.
